title: Soft!
text: Soft!. This towel set is pretty. It's very soft and comfy. I am a plus size middle aged woman. I wear a size 18 pants and a 2XL in tops. This is a little too big for me. It does have Velcro along the top, but to comfortably fit me, I have to pull it past where the other side of the Velcro is and the Velcro doesn't stick well enough to the towel material. I can wear it, but it's just a bit loose on me. I may try adding some more Velcro to it.
